verdict.rationale: The docs say Veo can turn images into short videos, and they describe multi-input reasoning that accepts image and video inputs alongside text, with character consistency. That covers the core idea of supplying a visual reference. No evidence explicitly documents generating new footage in a reference's style, and one hands-on report says Whisk with Veo 2 redraws the image so the output barely resembles the source. Missing for 10: explicit style-reference or style-transfer documentation, documented video-as-style-reference workflow, positive hands-on corroboration of reference fidelity.
